mean_cn: n.（北欧神话中的）穴居巨怪；  v.用曳绳钓；搜索，搜查
mean_en: (Scandinavian folklore) a supernatural creature (either a dwarf or a giant) that is supposed to live in caves or in the mountains
sentence: In Norse mythology, trolls are often depicted as ugly creatures living in caves.
sentence_trans: 在北欧神话中，穴居巨怪常被描绘为住在洞穴里的丑陋的生物。
